failure_modes: layout inspection covers only SCs not all characteristics

requirements.title: Appearance Items
requirements.intent: For appearance-critical products, approved appearance masters and approval records exist. Assessment is by trained personnel using approved conditions.
failure_modes: masters not replaced when worn or faded
requirements.applicability: When appearance characteristics are specified by customers.

requirements.title: Acceptance Records
requirements.intent: Records of product acceptance activities (inspection, test, first article) are retained and demonstrate conformity to acceptance criteria at all stages.
expected_evidence: Inspection records at all defined points
failure_modes: acceptance criteria not referenced in records
records not linked to specific production lot

requirements.title: Customer Authorization for Concession
requirements.intent: Concessions (use-as-is dispositions for nonconforming product) require customer authorization before implementation. Record of concession and customer authorization retained. Concession scope limited to agreed quantity and timeframe.
failure_modes: product shipped under concession not identified

requirements.title: Customer Notification of Nonconforming Product
requirements.intent: When nonconforming product has or may have shipped to the customer, the customer is notified per a defined process. Notification includes containment actions and timeline.
expected_evidence: customer-defined notification requirements implemented per CSR

requirements.title: Disposition of Nonconforming Product
requirements.intent: Nonconforming product is dispositioned as: rework, scrap, use-as-is (with authorization), return to supplier, or downgrade. Disposition is authorized. Scrapped product is rendered unusable before disposal.

requirements.title: Customer Controlled Shipping
requirements.intent: If placed under controlled shipping (CS1 or CS2) by a customer, the organization implements required additional inspection, containment, and reporting per the controlled shipping requirements. Exit criteria are defined and tracked.
failure_modes: third-party containment not implemented for CS2
requirements.applicability: When customer has imposed controlled shipping.

requirements.title: Monitoring and Measurement of Manufacturing Processes
requirements.intent: Statistical methods are used to monitor manufacturing process performance. Process capability (Cpk/Ppk) is evaluated for all special characteristics. Out-of-control and out-of-specification conditions trigger defined reactions.
expected_evidence: control limits vs. specification limits distinguished
failure_modes: Cpk/Ppk not meeting customer minimum (typically 1.67 for SCs initially)
no distinction between control limits and spec limits
reaction plans not executed when triggered

requirements.title: Acceptance of Conforming Product
requirements.intent: Acceptance of conforming product uses established criteria. No product is accepted based on operator discretion alone. Sampling plans are statistically valid and meet customer requirements.
failure_modes: Acceptance by operator judgment without defined criteria
sampling plans not meeting customer requirements

requirements.title: Internal Audit Program — Three Audit Types
requirements.intent: Internal audit program includes three types: quality management system audit (against IATF 16949), manufacturing process audit (against control plans and work instructions), and product audit (verification of product characteristics). All three types are conducted and scheduled appropriately.
expected_evidence: Audit program with three audit types
separate schedules for QMS, process, and product audits
coverage of all processes, shifts, and products
failure_modes: no process audit against control plans
all three combined into one audit without distinction

requirements.title: Problem Solving
requirements.intent: Organization uses a structured problem-solving methodology (8D, DMAIC, or equivalent) for all significant nonconformances. Root cause analysis uses appropriate tools (5-Why, Fishbone, fault tree). Escape point analysis is conducted. Mistake-proofing is considered as a corrective action.
expected_evidence: 8D or equivalent records for significant NCs
root cause analysis using structured tools
failure_modes: 8D used but escape point not analyzed

requirements.title: Error Proofing
requirements.intent: Error-proofing (poka-yoke) is used as a corrective action methodology and as a preventive measure in process design. Poka-yoke devices are tested at defined frequency. Failure of a poka-yoke device triggers a defined reaction.
expected_evidence: poka-yoke devices listed in control plans
reaction plan for failed poka-yoke test
new poka-yoke consideration in corrective action process
failure_modes: Poka-yoke devices not in control plans
no reaction plan for failed test
corrective action process does not consider poka-yoke

requirements.title: Continual Improvement Plan
requirements.intent: Organization has a documented continual improvement plan targeting reduced variation, waste elimination, and quality improvement. Plan includes specific targets, methods, and timelines. Customer scorecards and benchmarking inform improvement priorities.
expected_evidence: Continual improvement plan with targets and timelines
failure_modes: customer scorecard data not used for improvement planning
improvement plan not reviewed by management
